job.description:

This isn’t about spending the next three years doing exactly the same tickets with a slightly different job title. 

You’ll join talented, collaborative engineering teams where you’ll be encouraged to broaden your technical skills, get involved in projects, work directly with customers and gradually take on greater technical responsibility.

If you’re already working at Level 3 within an MSP/MSSP and wondering what the next chapter of your career could look like, this could be a fantastic move.

⭐ Why These Opportunities Stand Out
  • $110K-$130K + Super + training incentives
  • Melbourne - Hybrid working
  • Genuine investment in training and certifications
  • Projects, consulting, architecture, security and leadership
  • Exposure to Azure, Modern Workplace, infrastructure and security
  • Supportive technical leadership and mentoring
  • Interesting customers and varied environments
  • Strong, people-first cultures with excellent employee benefits
This is an established, highly regarded Australian technology business with strong reputations for client service, technical capability and long-term customer relationships.

More importantly, they understand that good engineers want more than a salary and a queue of tickets. They want progression, exposure, mentoring, responsibility and the opportunity to become better at what they do.

What You’ll Be Doing

Your role will be varied, giving you the opportunity to develop beyond traditional support work. Depending on your experience, you’ll be involved in:
